description: M1 v1.2 snapshot_freeze lifecycle self-test config (S06 synthetic, 1 Hz): enter@10s -> leave@28s -> re-enter@46s. Uses M1_default G1-calibrated parameters; background switched to snapshot_freeze with snapshot_frames=8 (completes inside the 10 s empty prefix) and re_snapshot_confirm=12 (rebuild triggers in the 18 s leave gap; returning person frames are skipped by the score guard and the partial snapshot freezes clean on re-confirm). Tests the release + rebuild + partial-freeze-on-return path that T01/P01 cannot (no leave event). NOT for real-device recordings - use M1_dev112p_v0.2.json there.
target_count_policy: 1 when presence=1 (single-seat region assumption, documented), 0 when empty, -1 when unknown
